name: Bodhi Tree Massage & Wellness Sanctuary
notes: All assets are local (zero external hotlinks). Owners can replace any slot from the onboarding wizard / website editor; uploads go to Supabase Storage (studioflow-media) and these files remain the fallbacks. Free-license photographs are from Pexels/Unsplash (free for commercial use, no attribution required); hero, Shirodhara, Rambagh garden and two therapist portraits are AI-generated for StudioFlow because no suitably licensed free photographs were available. All treatment imagery is professional and towel-covered.
